R14.search: Listed all files under agent/ and grepped for checkpoint, replay, recover, resume, idempot, hash, hmac, sign, retry, resend, sequence, reconcil, restart, crash, attempt, backoff, tenacity, and audit_events. Read audit.py, loop.py, main.py lifespan/sweeper, payments.py and migrations/001_init.sql. audit_events is only written (INSERT) by audit.record and is never read back by any application code. Each run starts fresh from the task, with no resume or checkpoint load. The only background job is the approvals expiry sweeper, which reads the approvals table and not logs. No retry or replay loop exists. pay_invoice makes a single POST with an Idempotency-Key, and a failure is recorded as tool_error and returned to the model.
R14.note: No logs or checkpoints drive recovery and there is no automatic replay, so the N/A condition is met and R14 does not apply.

E07.search_explanation: Read README, main.py, ingest.py, approvals.py, mcp_client.py, tools/slack.py, tools/documents.py and networkpolicy.yaml, and grepped the tree for webhook/callback/a2a/agent card/peer/response_url/reply_to. The only inbound routes are /runs (human OIDC JWT), /ingest/mail (mail gateway service, a non-agent HMAC-signed document feed), /slack/interactions (human approver button clicks) and /healthz. The ERP MCP server is a tool server the agent calls, and the LineItemExtractor sub-agent is an in-process call. There is no A2A server, no peer-agent endpoint, no agent card, and no peer-supplied callback or webhook URL.
E07.note: No other agent sends messages to this agent: inbound traffic comes from humans (OIDC, Slack approvers) and a non-agent mail gateway, so E07 is not applicable. Residual caveat: the mail gateway HMAC is a single shared key with no per-sender mapping, and the ingest payload takes business_unit from the body, which would matter if the gateway were treated as a peer.
